journey.name: lnurl scanner presentation keeps the active payment
journey.description:
Regression for iOS issue 1087: replacing the QR scanner with LNURL amount or confirmation must keep the current payment data. Closing a payment must not clear the data for a later payment. This is an iOS presentation lifecycle regression, not a change to Android payment behavior.
Use an onboarded regtest E2E build, a running Lightning node, and a usable channel with more than 1000 sats of spending balance. Resolve introductory sheets before starting. Use a local LNURL server reachable by the simulator. The regular bitkit-docker lnurl-server on port 23000 accepts GET /generate/pay?minSendable=149500&maxSendable=200999&commentAllowed=12 for the variable fixture, and GET /generate/pay?minSendable=N&maxSendable=N&commentAllowed=0 for fixed fixtures. Obtain links for N=222000, 222538, 222222 and 500500. These are millisatoshis. Use the returned lnurl strings, not BOLT11 invoice strings. Quick Pay must be off so fixed fixtures show confirmation instead of automatically paying. No payment is authorized in this journey.

actions.action: Open Settings, General, Quick Pay. Continue through its introduction if shown. Record the enabled state of "QuickpayToggle", turn it off if needed, verify it is off, and return to wallet home. Leave its amount and daily limits unchanged
Open Send (id "Send"), close it, and verify the wallet home screen is visible
Open the home QR scanner, then the E2E manual scan prompt (id "ScanPrompt")
Enter the variable LNURL fixture in "QRInput" and tap "DialogConfirm"
Verify "SendNumberField" and "ContinueAmount" are visible and the app remains open
Verify "ReviewAmount-primary" shows 150 and "CommentInput" is visible; do not swipe to pay
Dismiss the payment sheet and verify the wallet home screen is visible

For each fixed LNURL fixture in order (222000, 222538, 222222, 500500 msat), open the home QR scanner, enter its link through "ScanPrompt", "QRInput" and "DialogConfirm", and verify "ReviewAmount-primary" is visible with 222, 223, 223 and 501 sats respectively; "CommentInput" is absent and no amount-entry step is required
After each fixed confirmation, dismiss it without paying and verify the wallet home screen remains responsive before scanning the next fixture
Repeat the variable and fixed scan sequence five times, including opening and closing Send before a sequence; verify no empty payment sheet or app exit occurs
With all payment sheets closed, return to Quick Pay settings, restore "QuickpayToggle" to its recorded enabled state, verify it, and return to wallet home
